Irespeaker : nom de créature sans équivalent officiel ; proposition « Parle-colère » ; reste du texte est le paragraphe standard « Après la destruction de Draenor… ».
en: After the sundering of Draenor, most life was wiped out during collapse of the barrier between Draenor and the Twisting Nether and the resulting explosion. The wildlife that survived became sickly or corrupt, and many of Ner'zhul's portals were left permanently open, allowing all manner of dangerous beings to enter Outland and threaten our presence here.  The Irespeaker population is becoming a real threat. Travel to The Dawning Square and cull 6 of them.
